technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish (50/200 EMA/SMA, ADX strong) but short-term price action remains below key moving averages with MACD bearish; oversold bounce signals present but lack conviction without confirmed entry trigger.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 43 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/weak with small-amount trades 78-92 days old, and absent recent news sentiment limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4) with flat yield curve and imminent FOMC decision creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 43 days adds moderate event risk but is not immediate.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (50/200 EMA/SMA bullish, ADX strong) with oversold bounce signals (stoch cross, CMF cross, OBV divergence) and extreme fear contrarian opportunity suggest tactical entry near support at 118.021.
